commit.message:
Design dark fantasy UI

Implement a polished, responsive dark-fantasy RPG interface:
- Add parchment/stone-styled centered story window with location header
- Left Player Panel with pixel-art portrait and HP/Mana/XP/Level/Gold stats
- Right Action Panel with main actions and dynamic Choices section
- Bottom magical grimoire-style command input
- Ambient background effects: floating particles, fog/dust
- Terminal-style typography and glow effects with a cohesive dark palette
- Scrollable narrative feed and responsive layout
- Tailwind/CSS system updates for theme, glow, textures, and scrollbar styling

X-Lovable-Edit-ID: edt-19978717-83ab-4bec-b05c-8eda232859b8
